blocks.name: Area between a curve and a line

blocks.text: Area between a curve and a line
What is the area between a curve and a straight line?

blocks.alt: Notes fig1, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md:
- This is the area enclosed by a curve and a line between their **intersections**
- The intersections may need to be found using simultaneous equations

blocks.text: How do I find the area between a curve and a line by separating into two areas?

blocks.md:
- The area enclosed will be the **difference** between …

  - the **area under the curve** and
  - the **area under** the line
- These can be found separately

blocks.alt: Notes fig2, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md: - There may be easier ways to find the area under a line

blocks.alt: Notes fig3, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md: - Once the areas are found a question can be answered in full

blocks.alt: Notes fig4, AS & A Level Maths revision notes
Notes fig5, AS & A Level Maths revision notes
Notes fig6, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md:
- STEP 1: Find the intersections of the line and the curve
- STEP 2: Find the area under a curve, **R**<sub>**C**</sub>, using definite integration
- STEP 3: Find the area under a line, **R**<sub>**L**</sub>, either using definite integration **or** the area formulae for basic shapes
- STEP 4: To find the area, **R**, between the curve and the line **subtract** the **smaller **area **from** the **larger** area

  - If curve on top this will be **R**<sub>**C**</sub>** – R**<sub>**L**</sub>
  - If line on top this will be **R**<sub>**L**</sub>** - R**<sub>**C**</sub>

blocks.text: How do I find the area between a curve and a line by subtracting their equations?

blocks.md:
- An alternative method allows subtraction of the two functions first
- But be extremely careful as to whether the curve or the line is on top

blocks.alt: Notes fig7, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md:
- STEP 1: Find the intersections of the line and the curve
- STEP 2: Subtract the functions algebraically

  - Ensure this is done the correct way round!
- STEP 3: Find the area, **R**, between the curve and the line using **definite** **integration**

blocks.md:
- Add information to any diagram provided
- Add axes intercepts, as well as intercepts between lines and curves
